articles.title: Person dead after shooting involving officer in North York: Toronto police
articles.summary: A person has died after a shooting involving an officer in North York Saturday, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Showers, thunderstorms coming to the GTA this weekend: Environment Canada
articles.summary: Environment Canada has issued a special weather statement for heavy rainfall in the Greater Toronto Area and in Peel and Durham regions this weekend.

articles.title: Blue Jays' Guerrero Jr. returns to lineup against Yankees following head injury
articles.summary: Toronto Blue Jays slugger Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been reinstated from the seven-day injured list and will be active Saturday against the host New York Yankees.

articles.title: Businesses, officials praise success of car-free pilot project on Church Street
articles.summary: The pedestrianization pilot on Church Street is coming to an end Friday night with residents and officials raving about the boom in business and community vibes.

articles.title: 78-year-old woman dead after highway crash in Oakville: OPP
articles.summary: A 78-year-old woman is dead after a crash in Oakville Thursday evening, provincial police say.

articles.title: Another Toronto street festival is being lost to funding shortfalls
articles.summary: The co-founder of the Yorkville Murals festival says they were denied city grants awarded in previous years. More applications are leading to more competition for funding, according to a City of Toronto spokesperson.
